findings.title: Azure endpoint topology XML incorrectly promises an isolated copy despite shared message send and publish topology

nodes.before_text: Adds an isolated Azure Service Bus topology configuration to endpoint configuration.
nodes.proposed_text: Adds Azure Service Bus topology configuration to endpoint configuration.
nodes.actual_source_contract: Protected root construction stores the supplied topology; child construction shares message/send/publish topology through the actual topology copy constructor. No universal isolation.
nodes.actual185_before_xml:
<member name="T:ViciOne.ServiceBus.AzureServiceBus.Configuration.ServiceBusEndpointConfiguration">
            <summary>Adds an isolated Azure Service Bus topology configuration to endpoint configuration.</summary>
        </member>

nodes.before_text: Creates a child endpoint configuration and copies the current topology conventions into it.
nodes.proposed_text: Creates a child endpoint configuration with separate consume topology and shared message, send, and publish topology.
nodes.actual_source_contract: New ServiceBusTopologyConfiguration(Topology) retains three parent references and creates a new ServiceBusConsumeTopology; base child endpoint creates pipe/serialization/transport configuration under its own rules.
nodes.actual185_before_xml:
<member name="M:ViciOne.ServiceBus.AzureServiceBus.Configuration.ServiceBusEndpointConfiguration.CreateEndpointConfiguration(System.Boolean)">
            <summary>Creates a child endpoint configuration and copies the current topology conventions into it.</summary>
            <param name="isBusEndpoint">Whether the child configures the bus endpoint.</param>
            <returns>The child endpoint configuration.</returns>
        </member>

nodes.before_text: Creates a child endpoint configuration with an isolated copy of the current topology settings.
nodes.proposed_text: Creates a child endpoint configuration. The built-in implementation creates separate consume topology and shares message, send, and publish topology.
nodes.actual_source_contract: Bodyless SPI declares bool=false. Actual ServiceBusBusConfiguration inherits the concrete endpoint method and uses it for its bus endpoint. Summary explicitly scopes the sharing detail to that built-in implementation.
nodes.actual185_before_xml:
<member name="M:ViciOne.ServiceBus.AzureServiceBus.Configuration.IServiceBusBusConfiguration.CreateEndpointConfiguration(System.Boolean)">
            <summary>Creates a child endpoint configuration with an isolated copy of the current topology settings.</summary>
            <param name="isBusEndpoint">Whether the child represents the bus endpoint.</param>
            <returns>The child endpoint configuration.</returns>
        </member>

findings.title: Azure broker topology XML incorrectly promises immutable views while exposing mutable arrays

nodes.before_text: Provides an immutable snapshot of Azure Service Bus entity declarations and relationships.
nodes.proposed_text: Provides Azure Service Bus entity declarations and relationships in mutable arrays.
nodes.actual_source_contract: Constructor ToArray materializes five sequences without cloning entity references. Public array getters expose the same arrays; probe reads those arrays. No immutable or deep-copy guarantee.
nodes.actual185_before_xml:
<member name="T:ViciOne.ServiceBus.AzureServiceBus.Topology.ServiceBusBrokerTopology">
            <summary>Provides an immutable snapshot of Azure Service Bus entity declarations and relationships.</summary>
        </member>

nodes.before_text: Builds an immutable view over the collected entity relationships.
nodes.proposed_text: Materializes the collected entity declarations and relationships into a topology with mutable arrays.
nodes.actual_source_contract: Actual body passes the five accumulated entity collections to the topology constructor; the returned topology exposes materialized mutable arrays.
nodes.actual185_before_xml:
<member name="M:ViciOne.ServiceBus.AzureServiceBus.Topology.BrokerTopologyBuilder.BuildBrokerTopology">
            <summary>Builds an immutable view over the collected entity relationships.</summary>
            <returns>The complete Azure Service Bus broker topology.</returns>
        </member>

reconciliation: Different Azure owners from prior runtime snapshot/callback/entity-deployment findings; these are actual published XML discrepancies, not administrative matrix precision corrections.
